8. Fixed Local Business Schema

Previously, the website had a Local Business schema, but several structural and implementation issues were identified and fixed.

Issues Identified:

  • Duplicate Place entities with the same business address
  • Duplicate address information under both address and location
  • The business logo was incorrectly repeated as location.image
  • priceRange: $$$ was included without clear justification
  • areaServed was missing, despite the business serving multiple areas
  • The schema contained unnecessary nested and duplicate properties
  • The physical business address was not clearly separated from the wider service areas
